scripts.android:install: adb wait-for-device && adb shell 'while [ -z "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" ]; do sleep 1; done' && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.android:deploy: npm run build && npm run android:install-apk && npm run android:launch
scripts.android:logs: adb logcat --pid=$(adb shell pidof com.nutrisense.mobile) AuthRepository:D DashboardRepo:D DashboardVM:D IotRepository:D SettingsVM:D *:E
